nodes.label: Playlists
details: Downloaded YouTube playlists are checked for new videos on the channel schedule, with a bell notice and a Download button.

nodes.label: Settings
details: Notifications > Watch downloaded playlists turns playlist checks off.

nodes.label: Library
details: Save to playlist is a small popup with playlist covers and search, video playlists only.
Delete single videos from a pasted playlist.
Playlist downloads fly onto their playlist card when the Playlists tab is open.

nodes.label: Downloads
details: No console windows flash on screen after a download or when opening Settings > Downloads.
The download slot no longer gets stuck on a finished cover during long batches.

nodes.label: Channels
details: Followed creators keep loading new uploads when YouTube's channel feed fails, instead of Channel feed not found.

nodes.label: Library
details: Playlist covers use the video thumbnail instead of its first frame.

nodes.label: Music
details: The title bar avatar opens your profile from the video library.
